description: A dry run of the things you want to propose: for each line, whether its create would be allowed or the plan's refusal in its own words, the pace it would get, credits a month, and which existing monitor already watches that address; then the total against the credits. It runs the creates' own checks and creates nothing. Show the person the result and create only what they say yes to.

items.description: What you want to propose, up to 10 lines

kind.description: page = create_monitor, uptime = create_uptime_monitor, test = create_test, dataset = create_dataset, intelligence = an Intelligence brief

notify.description: What the person wants to be told about, as create_monitor's notifyWhen

pace.description: How often: for a page, minutes as create_monitor's frequency ('180'); for uptime, seconds as create_uptime_monitor's intervalSeconds ('300'). Leave out for the plan's default.

workspaceId.description: From list_workspaces; default the person's own
